cardFixesApplied.from: Volt patří do osobní a lehké užitkové nabídky Chevroletu. Tato souhrnná karta zachovává dosavadní modelovou identitu; regionální verze a všechny generace ještě nejsou úplně rozpracovány.
cardFixesApplied.to: Volt je pětidveřový plug-in hybrid s pohonnou soustavou Voltec. První generace se vyráběla od roku 2010; druhá přišla v roce 2015 jako modelový rok 2016 a výroba modelu skončila v roce 2019. Údaje druhé generace na této kartě se týkají severoamerického vozu, který se v Evropě může objevit jako dovoz.

openQuestions: Partial breadth-first pass: inventoried 76 cards / 84 generation-or-family records / 206 raw model entities; not all independently verified.
Seven current statuses refer to existing explicitly labelled family-level records. They do not claim each historic generation remains in production; detailed generation splitting is still needed.

GM current assembly-facility product lists directly support Colorado/Express (Wentzville), Corvette (Bowling Green), Silverado (Fort Wayne/Flint), Tahoe/Suburban (Arlington), Traverse (Lansing Delta).
Equinox EV, Silverado EV and Blazer EV require selected model-line/card additions; production start years remain null until independently scoped.
BrightDrop delivery vans and modern Bolt generation deserve follow-up; model-list inclusion policy and production changes not resolved.
No dates changed from model-year announcements. Camaro MY2024 does not automatically imply calendar production into 2024.
Historic and regional identities such as Alero, Lumina, Monza and S-10 need separate market/date reconciliation; no unsupported removals applied.
Existing engine rows, facelifts, photos and generation-code coverage were not comprehensively rechecked.

DEPTH 2026-10-29: selected Volt generation split only. Exact production-month boundaries and second-generation Europe/import homologation remain open. INL technical sheet corroboration is search-index evidence; direct fetch 403. No make-wide Chevrolet completion or photo verification claimed.
summary: Partial Chevrolet inventory pass corrected seven family production statuses using direct GM assembly-facility evidence and proposed three missing EV card/model-line identities.
